# Maxed synthetic demo v1

Every byte of `story.pcap` is generated by `crates/maxed-cli/src/demo.rs`.
No owner recording, player data, token, client asset or network connection was
used. Names and accounts are `DemoHero` / `DemoAccount` and `DemoAlly` /
`DemoAllyAccount`. Object IDs, character ID, MACs and catalog definitions are
synthetic; IPs are RFC 5737 documentation addresses. No HELLO or credentials are
required. This provenance does not certify any unrelated recording as scrubbed.

Generate a **new** output file (existing paths are refused):

```powershell
cargo run --offline -p maxed-cli -- make-demo target/maxed-demo-new.pcap
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 target/maxed-demo-new.pcap
cargo test --offline -p maxed-cli --test demo
cargo test --offline -p maxed-cli demo --lib
```

The committed pcap SHA-256 is
`fbbf9044a7c913c6594d2648b64f5c9a2556355b272b9f7573e17f3b19437f67`.
The command test regenerates to a temporary target path and compares both the
hash and every byte with this fixture. The writer is maxed-recording's classic
pcap writer. Packet bodies use the real directional RC4 constants; length and
ID headers remain clear. Ethernet/IPv4/TCP frames have valid checksums and a
three-way SYN handshake. Bodies are split across TCP segments.

## Story and expected results

| Capture time | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| 0 s | TCP handshake |
| 0.1 s | Nexus |
| 1 s | Realm; CREATE_SUCCESS and DemoHero / Demo Realm Foe UPDATE |
| 2 s | Realm encounter: 50 observed server damage, weapon 256 |
| 5 s | Snake Pit; CREATE_SUCCESS, hero, ally and boss UPDATE |
| 6 s | NEWTICK, local SERVERPLAYERSHOOT, server DAMAGE 100 |
| 8 s | NEWTICK, fame 100 → 125, second local shot, server DAMAGE 200 |
| 9 s | UPDATE identifies white bag 1292 and completes its contents: all eight slots observed, item 256 in slot zero |
| 9.1 / 9.2 s | Two NEWTICKs leave the bag unchanged; no bag events are emitted |
| 10 s | Victory notification `[14, 0]` |
| 12 s | Nexus; final fight/run summaries, then explicit capture stop |

The dungeon boss total is **300 damage, two hits, null DPS, share 1** for the
sole contributing player. Its two-second activity is below the three-second
DPS minimum. The ally is observed in the two-person party but
does not contribute damage in the base story. There is one Cleared dungeon
run, a 5-second time to completion, 7-second residence, and one white bag.
The Realm encounter is a separate 50-damage fight with no run ID. Damage times
come from the preceding tick receipt, not the shot's or hit's later receipt.
No ENEMYHIT estimate is used in this base story.

The 9 s UPDATE emits an initial `BagDropped` with unknown contents, immediately
followed by `DropUpdated` with complete contents and one recorded enchant
(synthetic ID 1). The two NEWTICKs do not enrich the bag. The final `DropUpdated`
at 12 s repeats the same bag state. Throughout `expected.json`, `source_enemy`
is null, `source_estimated` is false, and `source_reason` is
`"source-not-observed"`; no boss source attribution is recorded. Missing class
caps/maxed information remains unknown. The **only supported catalog** for
these fixture IDs is the accompanying `catalog.json`, fingerprint
`synthetic-maxed-demo-v1`; its boss 257, weapon 256 and canonical Snake Pit map
are test definitions, not representations of actual item IDs or loot tables.

`expected.json` pins the complete ordered `EventEnvelope` array, including
intermediate revisions, nullable fields, evidence and final summaries. Replay
uses `EngineConfig { stream_id: "demo-v1", identity_key: [7; 32],
..Default::default() }` and pcap microseconds as the fixed clock. There is no
wall-clock input. Event sequences start at one. The integration test compares
the serialized bytes to this golden file and to a second independent replay.
The P1 runtime join regenerated this array after ordering `CharacterUpdated`
before `CharacterMerged` and `FameChanged` references. This changes envelope
ordering only; the pcap bytes and all character/combat/outcome values are unchanged.
All 21 packets must decode with **zero unverified packets**, failures or unknown
IDs. Tests also independently validate checksums and the synthetic identifiers.

## Generated variants and limits

Unit tests generate additional pcaps in memory through the same recording writer and
replay path: duplicate TCP frames, reordered segments, absent dungeon UPDATE,
death before/after completion, capture gap followed by a fresh connection,
malformed counters, delayed bag contents, and an additional source story with
client PLAYERSHOOT/ENEMYHIT reconstruction plus observed ally damage. Both RC4
directions are exercised by the latter. Truncated input returns an error.

An absent UPDATE leaves target/source identity unknown and capture incomplete;
the engine excludes hits whose shooter is not known to be a player. A capture
gap preserves incomplete run evidence instead of inventing completion. Replay
gates unverified decoded packets before applying them to the engine.

Each replay constructs a fresh isolated engine and sequences its original
events. It writes no database or notifications. P2 loops must create a new
isolated engine/stream and use memory or a demo-only database. This fixture
verifies the synthetic pipeline only: live gameplay accuracy, Java parity,
asset extraction, persistence integration, UI behavior and performance budgets
are not established by it.

The base story has no quest-target confirmation: its sole-boss Victory evidence
is provisional. Under the confirmed-kill policy it remains open until map exit, ending with
`map_changed`, while retaining the provisional kill evidence. The golden event
array records this distinction; the pcap is unchanged.

The DPS PB reconciliation gate adds `pending_local_reconciliation` to fight
views. Local server-only pairs remain pending until expiry or retirement. The
12 s clock advance publishes one additional `FightUpdated` on expiry;
retirement publishes the fully settled `FightEnded`. The golden array was
regenerated through `replay_engine`; all previous event values (apart from
sequence numbering) and the pcap bytes are unchanged.
